full_judgment:
Bimalendu Bikash Roy Chowdhury, J.: This is a petition by one Jebunnessa (Rima) for leave to appeal from an order of a' Single Bench of the High Court Division, being Civil Order No. 5166 of 1998 dated 10 December 1998 summarily rejecting her revisional application filed against the order dated 19 November 1998 passed by the Subordinate Judge, Third Court, Dhaka allowing an application under Order 39 Rule 7 of the Code of Civil Procedure, hereinafter referred to as the Code, in Misc. Case No. 23 of 1998. 

 3. Subsequently respondent No. 1, Parveen Abedin made an application (Misc Case No. 23 of 1998) under Order 21 Rules 100 and 101 of the Code for restoration of possession alleging that in course of the execution the decree-holder had taken possession of the adjacent land belonging to her and ousted her there from. She also filed an application under Order 39 Rule 7 of the Code for appointment of an Advocate Commissioner to ascertain whether the petitioner had obtained possession of any land in excess of her decretal land. The prayer was allowed on 19 November 1998. 

 4. Against this order, the petitioner preferred a revisional application before the High Court Division which summarily rejected it holding that the court had jurisdiction to ascertain the identity of the land which is the subject-matter of the application under Order 21 Rules 100 and 101 of the Code and that there had been no failure of justice in the case. 

 5. The petitioner now seeks to contend that the High Court Division was wrong in holding that the order of the Subordinate Judge appointing an Advocate Commissioner for local inspection in the case was proper. But having examined the provision of Order 39 Rule 7 of the Code we find no fault with the order of the High Court Division passed in discretion. We see no reason to grant leave in this matter. The petition is accordingly dismissed.
